manufacturer_reference.scope: Published calculated reference point for 8 x 4.2 x 0.3 mm disc. Actual spring and assembled preload are unmeasured. CAD shows this reference height, not the position needed for calibrated hinge torque.

friction_model: Two uniform-pressure annular friction interfaces; torque=2*mu*F*rmean

chosen_comparison_window.scope: Proposed assembly acceptance criterion only, not achieved by a sample and not a sensory comfort threshold

limits: Density,coefficient and preload ranges are assumptions,not selected materials or measured properties
Friction changes with wear,humidity,contamination,creep and manufacturing
Gravity holding is a static orientation screen,not shake,bag handling or user safety
Wearing stop is intended to carry outward head reaction;friction still does not lock all directions
No torque comfort threshold or actual spring preload qualification
The 80 Nmm target and 20 percent window are chosen comparisons, not validated requirements
Uniform annular friction omits real pressure, bending, wear, disc spring seating and material creep
The 7.5 percent reduction is a catalogue reference tolerance, not a measured component guarantee
Static gravity holding does not establish resistance to shocks or inadvertent folding under an inward load
calibration_instructions: Measure hinge torque directly through its usable angular range after bedding the actual friction pair
Adjust the nut and remeasure; nut tightening torque alone is not hinge torque
Qualify a method of locking and retaining the nut and bolt; the CAD threads are envelopes only
Verify breakaway and running torque, both directions, after time, heat, humidity, cleaning and cycles
Do not infer spring height or nut position from this single catalogue force point
